comment: Functions whose constant result is the correct Windows behaviour on OSyx, each with the reason. The scanner counts them as implemented and lists them in the report; a function not named here that returns a constant is reported as a stub.

entries.IsDebuggerPresent: OSyx has no debugger interface for Win32 processes, so no process is ever being debugged and FALSE is the exact answer
entries.GdiFlush: drawing reaches PRISM in order already (see the comment at the function), so there is no batch to flush
